document_note: The PDF at https://cdn.semikey.com/upload/pdfs/4c/5e/4c5e315c6bb9cc2f9ecf223359e639c3.pdf (labeled v1.4 by caller) is actually Allwinner F133 Datasheet revision 2.3 (2024-03-05) per its revision history; values below are from that rev unless stated. F133 Datasheet v1.0 (2021-05-24) values differ (e.g., VDD-CORE/SYS typ 0.9 V, many TBD) and are noted where relevant.

VCC-IO.description: Power Supply for Digital Part (3.3 V only); also IO supply of PB, PC, PF and USB0/USB1 pins per Table 4-2

VCC-RTC.description: Power Supply for RTC (also RESET pin IO domain per Table 4-2)

VCC-PLL.description: Power Supply for System PLL (DCXO pins domain)

VCC-TVIN.description: Power Supply for TVIN (F133-B only; pin 107 NC on F133-A)

VCC-DRAM0/VCC-DRAM1.description: Power Supply for DRAM IO and DDR2 (in-package 64 MB DDR2)

VDD-CORE0/VDD-CORE1.description: Power Supply for CPU and System
notes: v1.0 listed TBD/0.9/TBD; MangoPi MQ (D1s) schematic uses 0.9 V

LDOA-OUT.description: Internal LDOA Output Voltage for Analog Device and IO

LDOB-OUT.description: Internal LDOB Output Voltage for VCC-DRAM

LDOA.max_current: NOT_FOUND in datasheet (MangoPi MQ schematic annotates '1.8V@0.26A')

LDOB.max_current: NOT_FOUND in datasheet (MangoPi MQ schematic annotates '1.8V/1.5V/1.35@0.4A')
LDOB.note: For F133 in-package DDR2, VCC-DRAM range is 1.7-1.9 V, so LDOB would need 1.8 V setting; Ta max is 70 C when VCC-DRAM uses internal LDO vs 75 C external (Table 5-2). How LDOB voltage is selected (register/fuse) NOT_FOUND in datasheet.

rails_requiring_external_supply: VCC-RTC, VCC-PLL, VCC-LVDS, VCC-TVIN, VDD18-DRAM, AVCC, HPVCC (1.8 V; can be fed from LDOA-OUT per DS 2.7.7 intent; reference design uses LDOA-OUT for VCC-PLL/VCC-RTC/VDD18-DRAM/VCC-LVDS and a separate XC6206 1.8 V LDO for AVCC/HPVCC/VCC-TVIN)
VCC-DRAM0/1 (1.8 V; either external DC-DC or internal LDOB-OUT)
internal_regulators.no_internal_core_regulator: Datasheet lists only LDOA/LDOB; no internal core DC-DC described -> 0.95 V core must be external (block diagram Figure 3-2 shows external 'DCDC 0.95 V', 'DCDC 3.3V', 'LDO 1.8 V').

decoupling_recommendations: NOT_FOUND in datasheet (refers to F133_Schematic_Diagram for crystal caps). See reference_design_notes.md for MangoPi MQ values.
max_current_per_rail: NOT_FOUND in datasheet (no per-rail current table in rev 2.3). GPIO max drive 6 mA each (Table 4-2 note [6]); default 4 mA.

rules: Consequent steps should not start before previous step supplies are stabilized within 90-110% of nominal, unless stated otherwise.
VCC-RTC must be ramped no later than other power rails.
VCC-IO must be ramped before VDD-SYS and VDD-CORE with a minimum delay of 2 ms (T1 > 2 ms).
VCC-DRAM needs to be stable before SDRAM driver initialization.
RESET must be held low during the entire power-on sequence until all other rails (except 24 MHz CLK) are stable for more than 64 ms (T2 > 64 ms).
24 MHz clock starts oscillating after RESET is released.
power_on_sequence_5_12_1.ambiguity: Figure text extraction groups rails; exact order among the 1.8/3.3 V groups other than the stated rules is figure-only.

power_off_sequence_5_12_2: After RESET goes low, the 24 MHz clock stops oscillating.
No special restrictions for other power rails.

reset.name: RESET

internal_reset_table_5_11.open_drain_output_voltage: -0.3 to 0.3*VCC V, test condition 'pull up 3.3 V'

reset.ambiguity: Table 5-11 test condition says pull-up 3.3 V but Table 4-2 lists RESET's supply as VCC-RTC (1.8 V). MangoPi MQ pulls RESET up with 10K to LDOA-OUT (1.8 V) + 0.1 uF to GND. Safe choice: pull up to 1.8 V (VCC-RTC domain).
reset.source: DS Table 4-2 p.25, Table 4-4 p.31, Table 5-11 p.50, 5.12

crystal_24MHz.tolerance_ppm: +/-50 at 25 C (20 ppm recommended; follow Wi-Fi chip spec if REFCLK-OUT feeds Wi-Fi)
crystal_24MHz.C0_note: simulation value; actual from crystal maker
crystal_24MHz.load_cap_values: NOT_FOUND in datasheet (refers to F133_Schematic_Diagram). MangoPi MQ: XTAL2520-24M CL=18pF, C8=C9=22pF

rtc_32k768.optional: Yes: internal RC 32.768 kHz oscillator calibrated by DCXO can be used if accuracy not critical (software must enable)
rtc_32k768.tolerance: no requirement; 20 ppm recommended if timing accuracy needed
rtc_32k768.load_cap_values: NOT_FOUND in datasheet. MangoPi MQ: 32.768K CL=12.5pF, C43=C45=22pF, R40 680K 1% across crystal

usb.USB0: USB 2.0 DRD (host+device), integrated PHY, device HS/FS
usb.usb_id_vbus_pins: None on package (no USB0-ID/VBUS-DET pins in Table 4-2)
usb.fel_usb_boot: Datasheet 2.2.1: BROM 'Supports mandatory upgrade process through USB and SD card'. FEL is over USB0 (D1-H UM 3.3 BROM, FEL = USB). See f133_boot_usb_facts.json.

epad: Labeled EPAD in pin map; function NOT_FOUND in datasheet text; reference schematic ties to GND. PCB exposed pad size D3/E3 5.72 mm REF (DS 7.2).
